description: FloofyCrew surface registry: stable names for host UI surfaces located by content fingerprints (Requirement 4.4). `dom` is a CSS selector over attributes the host renders literally (data-testid, ids, ARIA roles, literal class names); `bundle` is a literal or regex expected in the module text of the hashed chunk named by its stem (never by hash); `chunk` may list several stems, tried in order (a hook the bundler folds into a differently named shared chunk on another build — `useTheme` on 0.7.0.x is inside `terminal` on public 0.6.0). `fromBuild` is the host build each row was written against; the reporter and the Forge record where a row stops matching.

surfaces.name: shell.root
surfaces.description: The React mount point of the dashboard shell (index.html).

surfaces.name: dashboard.shell
surfaces.description: The dashboard grid (topbar / nav / content) once React has mounted.

surfaces.name: topbar
surfaces.description: The glass top bar of the shell.

surfaces.name: sidebar.nav
surfaces.description: The main navigation rail (desktop) — a <nav role=navigation> inside the shell.

surfaces.name: logo
surfaces.description: The brand logo image inside the sidebar collapse button (pack branding lands here).

surfaces.name: favicon
surfaces.description: The document icon link (the host's static one, plus #mc-theme-favicon when a pack brands it).

surfaces.name: theme.tokens
surfaces.description: The element carrying data-theme / data-mode (the CSS token scope).

surfaces.name: theme.custom-style
surfaces.description: Where the host injects a custom pack's generated CSS (<style id=mc-custom-theme-<slug>>); bundle-only because the element exists only while a pack is active.

surfaces.name: theme.reset-site
surfaces.description: The useTheme effect that resets a missing custom pack to the default theme (the site the reset-guard patch anchors on).

surfaces.name: theme.decor-slot
surfaces.description: The fixed full-viewport slot themes decorate (desktop layout).

surfaces.name: apps.page
surfaces.description: The App Store page area, present on /apps routes.

surfaces.name: settings.page
surfaces.description: The Settings page area, present on /settings routes.
